HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #13
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE

   C. Refusing to help a neighbour

   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Social and National Festivals.
   D. Say Social and National Festivals has no place in daily life.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Aspects of integrity? (1 mark)
